headline.purpose: The entry title, with a double ink rule under it.

title.purpose: Module headings. Section titles share the weight, leading, and tracking at 1.45rem.

body.purpose: The reading column, set in Literata and held to 70ch.

label.purpose: Navigation, footer, and other chrome in Atkinson Hyperlegible.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, snippets, and measured counts in Geist Mono.

motion.name: rule-draw
motion.purpose: The portal rule draws once from the left. Reduced motion shows it already drawn.

components.name: Solid button
components.description: Ink rectangle for Search and retry. The portal submit is the wider sibling.
components.css: .ds-btn-solid, .ds-btn-portal { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: var(--ink); color: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-solid { font-size: 1rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.7rem; } .ds-btn-portal { font-size: 1.05rem; padding: 0 1.25rem; } .ds-btn-solid:hover, .ds-btn-portal:hover { background: var(--accent-ink); color: var(--paper); } :host-context(.dark) .ds-btn-solid:hover, :host-context(.dark) .ds-btn-portal:hover { color: #102326; } .ds-btn-solid:focus-visible, .ds-btn-portal:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text button
components.description: Verdigris underline for copy, theme, rail, and install targets. Current state is an ink rule.
components.html: <button class="ds-text-button" type="button">Copy install</button> <button class="ds-text-button" type="button" aria-pressed="true">Copied</button>
components.css: .ds-text-button { border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-text-button:hover { color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-text-button[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); } .ds-text-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Underline field
components.description: Portal search field on a 2px ink underline. Browse fields use a 1px underline.
components.html: <input class="ds-field" type="search" placeholder="Search skills, agents, and shelves" aria-label="Search entries" />
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink); caret-color: var(--accent-ink); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.6rem 0.65rem 0; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--muted-ink); } .ds-field:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--ink); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Primary nav
components.description: Header links. Hover and the current page turn verdigris and underline.
components.html: IndexAgentsRecent changes
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.9rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-nav a { color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--accent-ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Infobox plate
components.description: Ruled fact plate beside the reading column. A missing version stays unlabeled as a number.
components.css: .ds-plate { border-top: 3px double var(--ink); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; padding: 0.75rem 0 1rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper); font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-plate-name { font-family: var(--font-serif), Literata, Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-size: 1.25rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; margin: 0; } .ds-plate dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 6.2rem minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 0.35rem 0.6rem; margin: 0.7rem 0 0; } .ds-plate dt { color: var(--muted-ink); font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-plate dd { margin: 0; } .ds-plate a { color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-plate a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.18em; } .ds-plate a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Shelf cell
components.description: A shelf name and a tabular count inside the hairline grid.
components.css: .ds-shelf { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.8rem; min-height: 5.6rem; padding: 0.9rem 1rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; } .ds-shelf-name { font-family: var(--font-serif), Literata, Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-shelf-count { font-family: var(--font-mono), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--muted-ink); } .ds-shelf:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-ink) 8%, transparent); } .ds-shelf:hover .ds-shelf-name { color: var(--accent-ink); } .ds-shelf:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent-ink); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Code snippet
components.description: Install and source blocks on code paper, in Geist Mono.
components.css: .ds-snippet { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 0; background: var(--code-bg); color: var(--ink); padding: 0.85rem 1rem; font-family: var(--font-mono), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Score mark
components.description: Lint score and its word, in the plate and in results.
components.css: .ds-score { display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.35rem; font-family: var(--font-sans), "Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-score-num { font-family: var(--font-mono), "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-score-clean { color: var(--clean); } .ds-score-noted { color: var(--noted); } .ds-score-blocked { color: var(--blocked); }

components.name: Entry title
components.description: Article title opened by a double ink rule drawn under the words.
components.css: .ds-entry-title { margin: 0; font-family: var(--font-serif), Literata, Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: clamp(2.15rem, 4vw, 3.15rem); letter-spacing: -0.03em; line-height: 1.08; color: var(--ink); border-bottom: 3px double var(--ink); padding-bottom: 0.35rem; }

components.name: Portal rule
components.description: The single verdigris rule under the portal tagline. It draws once.
components.css: .ds-portal-rule { width: min(14rem, 40%); height: 1px; background: var(--accent-ink); transform-origin: left center; animation: ds-rule-draw 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } @keyframes ds-rule-draw { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-portal-rule { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Skilldex is a reference desk on warm paper. The portal answers what the encyclopedia holds: a serif name, a tagline, one verdigris rule, a search, a counts line, and shelves of names. An entry is an article, with a title, a lede, a reading column, and a ruled plate of facts. The tone is scholarly and plain.

Literata carries titles and the reading column. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries chrome. Geist Mono carries code and counts. Corners are square. Depth comes from a hairline, a double ink rule, or a code-paper block, never from a shadow. A CSS turbulence overlay grains the paper. Dark mode keeps the same roles on dark paper.

The desk does not borrow another reference work’s logo, wordmark, or skin. Streetwear, daylight, data-strobe, cutting-bench, orienteering, and monochrome marketing are declined: they drop the pinned paper and ink, or they stop the page reading as an article.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper, near-black ink, and one verdigris accent
Literata for reading and titles; Atkinson Hyperlegible for chrome; Geist Mono for code and counts
Square corners, with rules instead of shadows
A double ink rule on titles and plates, and one verdigris rule under the portal tagline
Paper grain as a CSS turbulence overlay, with no shipping rasters
Dark paper repeats the same relationship

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Verdigris is the only accent. It marks links, focus, the portal rule, and the solid-button hover. Clean, noted, and blocked are lint ink, not a second brand color.

rules.name: The Same Relationship Rule
rules.body: Dark mode reassigns paper, ink, accent, rule, code paper, and the three lint inks. It does not introduce a new brand.

rules.name: The Two Jobs Rule
rules.body: Literata carries the portal name, entry titles, section headings, shelf names, plate names, the lede, and the reading column. Atkinson Hyperlegible carries navigation, search, buttons, labels, tables, and the footer. Geist Mono carries code and measured counts.

rules.name: The Article Measure Rule
rules.body: The lede, the reading column, see-also, references, glossary definitions, and empty notes stay within 70ch.

rules.name: The Ruled Column Rule
rules.body: Every page frame is min(76rem, calc(100% - 2rem)), centered. At 1100px an article places a 13.25rem rail beside a reading column no wider than 70ch, with the plate in a 16–19.5rem track.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. Depth is a hairline, a double rule, a code-paper block, or an 8% verdigris wash on a shelf. There is no drop shadow.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: Texture is the fixed turbulence overlay on the body: opacity 0.045 and multiply on light paper, opacity 0.07 and overlay on dark paper. It is not an image asset.

rules.name: The Square Rule
rules.body: Radius is 0 on every corner, including controls, plates, and code blocks.

rules.name: The Double Rule
rules.body: A 3px double ink rule opens an entry title (drawn under the title), a module, an empty note, the footer, and an infobox plate. The single verdigris rule is only the portal rule under the tagline.

rules.name: The Underline Control Rule
rules.body: Search and fields are transparent, with an ink underline (1px in the header and on browse fields, 2px on the portal search). A solid action is an ink rectangle that turns verdigris on hover. A text action is a verdigris underline with no fill; the current or pressed text action switches to ink with a 1px ink rule.

dos: Do keep light paper, ink, and verdigris on #f4efe4, #1c1915, and #0e4f57, and dark paper, ink, and verdigris on #16130f, #f3eee4, and #9fd4ce.
Do focus with a 2px verdigris outline offset 3px, and keep the skip link in ink on paper.
Do draw the portal rule over 900ms with cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), and leave it fully drawn when the reader asks for reduced motion.
Do set shelf counts and lint scores in Geist Mono with tabular figures.
Do take the display name from SITE_NAME.
donts: Don't add a second accent, a gradient, or a drop shadow.
Don't ship a raster texture, logo, or wordmark. Grain stays the CSS turbulence overlay.
Don't set the reading column in Atkinson Hyperlegible.
Don't set navigation, buttons, or meta labels in Literata.
Don't print a version, a price, or a customer mark. An unrecorded version stays “Not recorded”.
